purpose: Concept references for manual animation; not production sprite sheets

characters.name: clawd
characters.prompt: Edit this Clawd fighter concept with ONE anatomical correction: it must have FOUR clearly visible short block legs, like the original Clawd mascot, not three. Arrange four distinct terracotta block legs across the lower edge with transparent gaps between all four. Keep the entire rest of the image unchanged: wide terracotta rectangular body, two black square eyes, two block side arms, chunky retro arcade pixel style, upper-left lighting, pose, framing and transparent alpha background. Do not add a mouth or text. All four feet fully within canvas.

characters.name: grok
characters.prompt: Create ONE isolated full-body concept sprite for a premium 1990s 2D arcade fighting game. Image 1 is this character's IDENTITY reference. Image 2 is STYLE ONLY: match its chunky crisp pixel outlines, square pixel clusters, bold dimensional shading, upper-left light and overall rendering quality, but NEVER copy its orange character or anatomy. Aim at a 120-pixel-tall sprite enlarged with nearest-neighbor clarity. Use flat limited-palette color bands, not smooth gradients, 3D rendering or anti-aliased illustration. Grok: a simple BLACK floating orb, exactly two WHITE elongated oval eyes set toward the upper-right face. Preserve limbless anatomy: NO arms, legs, mouth, accessories or human anatomy. Near-black body with restrained charcoal pixel-cluster highlight bands to show volume, still unmistakably black. Slight dynamic forward tilt toward RIGHT, poised to spring. Default form ONLY: no colored effects or alternate forms. Entire round silhouette visible. One pose only, centered with generous margins on a square canvas. GENUINELY TRANSPARENT background with alpha, no checkerboard drawn in, no floor or cast shadow, no scenery, labels or text besides the described chest mark. No sprite sheet.
